entities.summary: Rene Swette is an Austrian professional ice hockey goaltender who is currently playing for HC TWK Innsbruck of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Austria men's national ice hockey team.
